benchmark_multimodal_processor: run the multimodal processor benchmark on a vLLM model with a specified dataset and number of prompts
get_timing_stats_from_engine: get all multimodal timing stats from a vLLM LLM engine including preprocessing and encoder forward pass metrics
calculate_mm_processor_metrics: calculate aggregate metrics like mean, median, std, and percentiles from multimodal processor timing stats by stage
collect_mm_processor_stats: collect multimodal processor timing stats from a vLLM engine returning a dictionary mapping stage names to lists of timing values
add_cli_args: add command-line arguments for the multimodal processor benchmark including dataset name, num prompts, and output options
